description: This file defines a PHP class 'Shipping' within the OpenCart eCommerce platform. The class manages shipping-related functionalities during the checkout process, including displaying shipping options, generating shipping quotes, and saving selected shipping methods. It interacts with session data, models for countries and zones, and shipping methods to facilitate dynamic shipping calculations and updates.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class handling shipping options and quotes during the checkout process in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping options and address form if shipping is applicable; returns HTML view.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Generates shipping quotes based on customer address data, validates address info, and returns shipping methods in JSON.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method into session data and returns success or error in JSON.
